title: small rolling wire racks
text: small rolling wire racks. These are pretty basic... took husband about 30 minutes to put both together (I ordered 2 - you only get 1 with each order).  They are sturdy, but not super heavy duty - perfect for my use.  I chose the racks with roller feet - note, they came with regular feet already attached, so if I changed my mind, .  Very easy to roll.  I also purchased separately some plastic, ribbed, clear shelf liner to place on the shelves, to help stop things from slipping through - the 12" wide leaves a small area near the edges uncovered, but it works for me.  The measurements given are accurate.  They are shiny silver metal, with black plastic pieces and black plastic roller feet.  All in all, I think these are a good value, delivered right to your door.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope this info was helpful to you!
